snippet.title: Crimson Capes - "Brotherhood" Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now and play the demo on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2488540/Crimson_Capes/

Play CO-OP with your friends or invade other witch hunters in MULTIPLAYER PVP.

Engage in fluid 2D pixel art swordplay, hunt down witches, fight monsters and experience the age of high adventure. Enter the guild of the Crimson Capes and explore a fantasy world of Sword and Sorcery.

#soulslike #pixelart #steamnextfest
